# Economy: economy (ECON)

An economy: output, growth, prices, jobs, debt and external balance, and output by sector, from World Bank, IMF and CIA data. One row per economy, keyed by ECONOMY_ID. Read by the **world-economy** pack's connector `macro-store` (table `<root>/macro/economy/`). There is **no committed test data** for this kind: the sample comes from the pack's samples (`config/packs/world-economy/samples/economy.jsonl`, 213 records). A bank or a public refresh delivers it in the same JSON Lines shape.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `config/packs/world-economy/samples/economy.jsonl` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line |
| Key field | `ECONOMY_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the pack's samples are served on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | `NAME`, `ISO3`, `REGION_NAME`, `INCOME_NAME`, `GDP_USD_BN`, `GDP_PER_CAPITA`, `GROWTH`, `INFLATION`, `UNEMPLOYMENT`, `POPULATION_M` |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | no committed files |

## Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ECONOMY_ID` | string | required | The record's id (the business key) | pattern `^ECON-` | `"ECON-AFG"` |
| `NAME` | string | required | The country or territory, with the name the World Bank uses. | — | `"Afghanistan"` |
| `ISO3` | string | required | The country's ISO 3166 alpha-3 code. | — | `"AFG"` |
| `REGION_NAME` | string | required | The World Bank geographic region the economy belongs to. | one of `East Asia & Pacific`, `Europe & Central Asia`, `Latin America & Caribbean`, `Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan`, `North America`, `South Asia`, `Sub-Saharan Africa` | `"Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan"` |
| `INCOME_NAME` | string | required | The World Bank income group (High income, Upper middle income, Lower middle income, Low income). | one of `High income`, `Low income`, `Lower middle income`, `Upper middle income` | `"Low income"` |
| `CURRENCY` | string | optional (filled in 91% of rows) | The currency code as the source gives it. | — | `"AFA"` |
| `CAPITAL` | string | optional (filled in 98% of rows) | The capital city's name, from the CIA World Factbook. | — | `"Kabul"` |
| `YEAR` | string | required | The year of the headline figures. | seen: `2025`, `2024`, `2022`, `2023`, `2015`, `2018`, `2020`, `2021` | `"2024"` |
| `GDP_USD_BN` | number | required | The value of all goods and services produced in the economy in a year, in current US dollars at market exchange rates. | unit: USD billions | `17.7785` |
| `GDP_PER_CAPITA` | number | required | GDP divided by the mid-year population, in current US dollars. | unit: USD | `416.871` |
| `GROWTH` | number | optional (filled in over 99% of rows) | The yearly change of GDP after removing inflation, so it measures the growth of output rather than of prices. | unit: % a year | `1.87319` |
| `INFLATION` | number | optional (filled in 89% of rows) | The yearly change of consumer prices (the consumer price index). | unit: % a year | `-6.60119` |
| `UNEMPLOYMENT` | number | optional (filled in 87% of rows) | The share of the labour force without work but available for and seeking employment (ILO modelled estimate). | unit: % of labour force | `13.351` |
| `DEBT_TO_GDP` | number | optional (filled in 89% of rows) | General government gross debt as a share of a year's GDP (IMF), the usual measure of how heavy public debt is. | unit: % of GDP | `8` |
| `CURRENT_ACCOUNT` | number | optional (filled in 90% of rows) | Net exports of goods and services plus net income and transfers, as a share of GDP. | unit: % of GDP | `-15.7183` |
| `RESERVES_USD_BN` | number | optional (filled in 83% of rows) | Total reserves including gold (World Bank). | unit: USD billions | `9.74895` |
| `TRADE_SHARE` | number | optional (filled in 88% of rows) | Trade (exports plus imports) as a share of GDP (World Bank). | unit: percent of GDP, in points | `83.763` |
| `POPULATION_M` | number | required | Total mid-year population of the latest year, in millions (World Bank SP.POP.TOTL divided by one million). | unit: millions | `43.8441` |
| `GROWTH_PATH` | array of objects | required (filled in over 99% of rows) | Real GDP growth by year, one element per year: YEAR and GROWTH in % a year (World Bank). | — | [10 objects] |
| `GROWTH_PATH[].YEAR` | string | required | The calendar year of the observation. | — | `"2015"` |
| `GROWTH_PATH[].GROWTH` | number | required | Real GDP growth in that year. | seen: `5`, `-8`, `-5`, `1`, `3`, `4`, `8`; unit: % a year | `1.45131` |
| `GDP_PATH` | array of objects | required | GDP in current US dollars by year, one element per year: YEAR and GDP in USD billions (World Bank). | — | [10 objects] |
| `GDP_PATH[].YEAR` | string | required | The calendar year of the observation. | — | `"2015"` |
| `GDP_PATH[].GDP` | number | required | GDP in current US dollars in that year. | seen: `11456`, `1528`, `18295`, `19498`, `21540`, `270`, `2724`, `29298`; unit: USD billions | `19.1342` |
| `SECTORS` | array of objects | required (filled in 96% of rows) | Value added by sector, one element per sector (Agriculture, Industry, Services): SECTOR and SHARE in % of GDP (World Bank). | — | [3 objects] |
| `SECTORS[].SECTOR` | string | required | Agriculture, industry or services, as the World Bank groups value added. | one of `Agriculture`, `Industry`, `Services` | `"Services"` |
| `SECTORS[].SHARE` | number | required | The sector's value added as a share of GDP. | unit: % of GDP | `45.1615` |
| `REGION_GROUP` | string | required | The economy's World Bank region: an id of the computed country-group kind (ECG-<World Bank region code>, ECG-LCN). | pattern `^ECG-`; links to `country-group` | `"ECG-MEA"` |
| `INCOME_GROUP` | string | required | The economy's World Bank income group: an id of the computed country-group kind (ECG-HIC, ECG-UMC, ECG-LMC, ECG-LIC). | pattern `^ECG-`; links to `country-group` | `"ECG-LIC"` |
| `LABOUR` | string | optional (filled in 87% of rows) | The economy's labour market: an id of the labour-market kind (LABR-<ISO3>); absent when the World Bank has no labour data. | pattern `^LABR-`; links to `labour-market` | `"LABR-AFG"` |
| `FISCAL` | string | optional (filled in 90% of rows) | The economy's public finances: an id of the fiscal-position kind (FISC-<ISO3>). | pattern `^FISC-`; links to `fiscal-position` | `"FISC-AFG"` |
| `OUTLOOK` | string | optional (filled in 90% of rows) | The economy's IMF outlook: an id of the economic-forecast kind (FCST-<ISO3>-WEO). | pattern `^FCST-`; links to `economic-forecast` | `"FCST-AFG-WEO"` |
| `INDICATORS` | array of strings | required | The economy's macro indicators: ids of the macro-indicator kind (MACRO-<ISO3>-<indicator>). | links to `macro-indicator` | [16 values] |

## Fields in other rows

None: all 213 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `ECONOMY_ID` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `ECONOMY_ID`, `NAME`, `ISO3`, `REGION_NAME`, `INCOME_NAME`, `YEAR`, `GDP_USD_BN`, `GDP_PER_CAPITA`, `POPULATION_M`, `GROWTH_PATH`, `GDP_PATH`, `SECTORS`, `REGION_GROUP`, `INCOME_GROUP`, `INDICATORS`, `PROVENANCE` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `ECONOMY_ID` per snapshot.
- `ECONOMY_ID` matches `^ECON-`.
